intent: Deleting an account removes the evaluation graders its workspace wrote, as the retention declaration already promised.
observable_outcome: After account purge no grader or grader version of the deleted workspace remains; platform graders are unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Account purge deletes the deleted workspace's graders and their versions.
Platform graders, which no workspace owns, survive another account's purge.
The approval that makes the record reviewed is checkable outside the package.
